# Morocco Cosmetic

Morocco Cosmetic is a cosmetic factory in Marrakech, Morocco. We press argan oil, make Moroccan black soap, and fill, label, and ship Moroccan cosmetic products for distributors, spas, online retailers, and brands. We supply bulk raw materials, ready-to-sell retail packs, and private label (OEM) manufacturing.

## Main pages (English)

- https://www.moroccocosmetic.com/ — Moroccan cosmetic products wholesale from our Marrakech factory.
- https://www.moroccocosmetic.com/about/ — About our Marrakech production and export hub.
- https://www.moroccocosmetic.com/products/ — Wholesale catalog: argan oil, ghassoul, floral waters, and more.
- https://www.moroccocosmetic.com/private-label-moroccan-cosmetics/ — Private label and OEM cosmetics manufacturing.
- https://www.moroccocosmetic.com/benefits/ — Why buyers work directly with our factory.
- https://www.moroccocosmetic.com/contact/ — Wholesale catalog and quote requests.
- https://www.moroccocosmetic.com/blog/ — Ingredient and packaging guides from our workshop.
